title: US NATO Envoy Whitaker: Europe Troop Review Will Follow 'America First', Allies Denying Base Access to Be 'Re-evaluated'
detail: Speaking at Euronews' Defence & Space Summit in Brussels on September 30 (reported October 1), US Ambassador to NATO Matthew Whitaker said the Pentagon's Europe force posture review is 'a force posture and basing review' guided by what is 'in the interest of the United States', and that Washington would 're-evaluate' relationships with allies that denied access to bases or airspace during Operation Epic Fury (Spain, Italy, France and the UK initially restricted access). He disputed leaked reports that up to 40,000 US troops could be withdrawn.

title: Rutte at Brussels Summit: NATO Is Defensive, Russia Should Stop Nuclear Threats; Europe Must Take More Responsibility
detail: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte told Euronews' Defence & Space Summit in Brussels that NATO is a defensive alliance and that Russia should stop its nuclear threats following Moscow's warnings to NATO over Kaliningrad. He also argued that a Chinese move against Taiwan or elsewhere in the First Island Chain would heavily affect Europe and the US, requiring Europe to shoulder more of its own defense.

media.caption: Rutte on NATO's defensive posture, Sept 30, 2026

title: Russia Warns of Nuclear Response to Any NATO Kaliningrad Blockade
detail: Moscow sent a diplomatic warning that it would use its 'entire arsenal', including nuclear weapons, if NATO tried to blockade Kaliningrad, and accused the alliance of a 'dangerous and reckless course'. NATO denied threatening Russian territory and urged Russia to stop 'irresponsible nuclear rhetoric'.
